summary: The deploy parcours classifies an external provider authorization to redo (Google access expired or revoked) as inconclusive with reason provider_authorization_expired, like a provider outage: never a rollback nor a refused activation. The cause is read first from the typed tool result of the judged owner turn (agent transcript, read-only, this turn only: a failed samantha_* result whose facts.reason is one of the playbooks Google authorization codes); the owner sentence (« L’accès à ton agenda Google a expiré : il faut le reconnecter. » and close rewordings) counts alone only when the turn's tool results are unknown, and fails as unconfirmed_provider_authorization when they were read and name no such cause. Without either signal the generic « n’a pas abouti » stays broken_reply; any other failed path still fails the run.
reason: S24 31/10 12:02 Tunis: owner_read « Qu'est-ce que j'ai dans mon agenda demain ? » -> samantha_agenda agenda.event.read -> FAILED, facts {state: unverified, reason: google_authorization_unavailable}, answer « La demande n’a pas abouti. Consulte le détail avant toute nouvelle action. », repeated by the brain. Real cause: Google refused the token refresh (invalid_grant, token expired or revoked). The parcours classified broken_reply and refused the activation of an unrelated playbooks PR (Orange), PARCOURS_FAILED; Amine had to reconnect (tools/reauthorize_agenda_google.py) before anything could be activated. Also: with the playbooks fix that names the cause, the base parcours would have judged « L’accès à ton agenda Google a expiré… » as passed.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-deploy-parcours.py
tests.evidence: 12 tests (4 new, class ProviderAuthorization), already registered in ci.yml (Deployment acceptance — five representative paths). Fixture s24-2026-10-31-agenda-auth-revoked: the observed tool result in a temporary transcript gives cause google_authorization_unavailable and the observed generic reply becomes inconclusive provider_authorization_expired; without the cause it stays failed broken_reply. The new playbooks sentence and rewordings are inconclusive when the tool results are unknown or name the cause, failed unconfirmed_provider_authorization when read without it. Only this turn's rows of this session count; non-typed tools, other causes and unreadable rows never count; a missing transcript is unknown. run_all: the reason is in the receipt row, another broken path still fails the run. On the base the new tests error (verdict/run_all have no cause, no TurnCauses) and the base verdict of the new sentence is passed/ok.

capabilities.reason: Deployment acceptance only; no route or capability.

architecture.reason: Same parcours owner, paths and exit codes; the transcript is read read-only from the store claw-live.py already reads. No new store, registry, router, scheduler or daemon.

limitations: The transcript row shape (session_nodes.session_key -> current_session_id, transcript_events.event_json toolResult with toolName and text content) comes from the deployed reader installer/termux-lite/claw-live.py and the observed tool result; a raw row of the recette session was not captured on the S24 (no phone access in this lot). If it differs, cause() returns unknown and the sentence decides, as before.

An inconclusive run keeps the activation (activate-ui-playbooks.sh exit 3, companion-deploy.sh no rollback): the agenda path is then not verified for that deployment; the receipt row names provider_authorization_expired.
deploy-after-maint.sh is not in this repository nor in samantha-ui-playbooks; its handling of exit 3 was not inspected.
Live proof after deployment: next parcours with a valid token (owner_read passed) and, at the next real refusal, the receipt row.
rollback: Revert this commit; an expired provider authorization is again judged broken_reply (generic sentence) or passed (named sentence).
